planets.name: TOI-451 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-451 with a 9.19-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-451 c was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-451. Its orbit and size follow Barragán et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
